title: Nextflow task hash spec schema
description: Schema for a task hash version: which keys feed the task hash, and which lineage record fields carry each key

id.description: Identifier of this task hash version, e.g. std/v2

note.description: Which releases this version covers and what changed in it

keys.description: The keys that feed the task hash. Their order is not significant

lineage.description: Fields of the lineage TaskRun record that carry this key. An empty list means the key is not recorded, and a consumer must report it as unseen rather than as unchanged
